Body.Content:
eDiscovery users will be able to view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned or created by a selected person. These containers store content from apps such as Microsoft Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks.

GA date: October CY2026

Preview date: September CY2026
